|rulings=* [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] may only follow a character if their destination is within range of his landspeed.<ref name="scomp">[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Vader%27s%20Anger%20%28V%29 Scomp: Vader's Anger (V)]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174249/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json Internet Archive]</ref>
* [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] may even follow a character moving across his site.
* [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] may not follow a vehicle, even if there is a character inside.
* If [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] is aboard a vehicle, he may not disembark it to follow. The entire vehicle may not follow either.
* Total battle destiny +1 counts all characters in the battle (including [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]).
* If Dark did not successfully complete any battle destiny draws, there is no total battle destiny and so it is not possible for this Interrupt to add to total battle destiny.

* '''Playtest''' ([[Vader's Anger (V) (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-vadersanger-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/vadersanger.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “If a lightsaber swung by Vader just 'hit' a character, cancel that character's game text. OR If you just drew Vader for destiny, take him into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. OR At Vader's site, cancel Blast The Door, Kid!; Dodge; or Rebel Barrier.”
* '''Original''' ([[Vader's Anger (V)]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-D-vadersanger-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/vadersanger.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “If a lightsaber swung by Vader just 'hit' a character, cancel that character's game text. OR If you just drew Vader for destiny, take him into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. OR At Vader's site, cancel Blast The Door, Kid!; Dodge; or Rebel Barrier.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 12 May 2020): Players Committee card image, 12 May 2020: [[:File:V11-D-vadersanger-20200512.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/large/vadersanger.gif Holotable commit a5142dd “Tweak set images”]), mark “E”. Text: “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel your lightsaber weapon (or 'choke') destiny draws. OR If Vader in battle alone, your total battle destiny is +1 for each character in battle. OR Cancel It's A Trap!” '''What changed:''' the whole game text was replaced: “If a lightsaber swung by Vader just 'hit' a character, cancel that character's game text. OR If you just drew Vader for destiny, take him into hand to cancel and redraw that destiny. OR At Vader's site, cancel Blast The Door, Kid!; Dodge; or Rebel Barrier.” became “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel your lightsaber weapon (or 'choke') destiny draws. OR If Vader in battle alone, your total battle destiny is +1 for each character in battle. OR Cancel It's A Trap!”

* '''PC-E2''' ([[Vader's Anger (V) (Errata 2)]], 20 December 2021): Players Committee card image, 20 December 2021: [[:File:V11-D-vadersanger.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f54fd7/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Dark/hires/vadersanger.png Holotable commit 6f54fd7 “Set 17 images”]), mark “E2”. Text: “Vader follows (using landspeed for free) an opponent's character that just moved from same site. OR If Vader in battle alone, your total battle destiny is +1 for each character in battle. OR If Vader in battle, cancel Dodge, It's A Trap!, or Obi-Wan's Journal.” '''What changed:''' “For remainder of turn, opponent may not cancel your lightsaber weapon (or 'choke') destiny draws.” became “Vader follows (using landspeed for free) an opponent's character that just moved from same site.”; “Cancel It's A Trap!” became “If Vader in battle, cancel Dodge, It's A Trap!, or Obi-Wan's Journal.”; re-rendered at high resolution.
